text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Visiting Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati handed President Ben Ali an invitation to an Islamic summit next December in Tehran.
- President Ben Ali and Libyan Leader Muammar Gaddafi discussed over the phone on Monday the Arab Maghreb Union (AMU) situation and Middle East developments.
- President Ben Ali received trade unions leader Ismail Sahbani who expressed satisfaction with the conclusion of wages negotiations.
- Popular Unity Party (opposition) reshuffles its political bureau.
- Tourism Minister Slaheddine Maaoui says receipts in 1996 amounted to 1.43 billion dinars and arrival of European tourists rose by seven percent compared to 1995.

- A European Union delegation including Dutch Foreign Minister and European council of ministers' chairman Hans van Mierlo held talks with Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari. It was also received by Prime Minister Hamed Karoui.
